> **2026-11-06 prototype review refresh (source revision 76668760adf4):** [Direct interactive HTML](https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/claude-memory-2689/index.html) (**Pages update not yet verified**) · [Immutable prototype source](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/76668760adf4efa344419b5406360aef681d5529/claude-memory-2689/index.html) · [Scenario/fidelity](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/76668760adf4efa344419b5406360aef681d5529/claude-memory-2689/README.md). The shared #2758 presentation structure is used across the gallery. Static source checks passed; current Chromium browser interaction, product fixture comparison and exact Pages manifest readback **not verified**. Previous source SHAs below are historical. Public prototype mocks do not establish production Acceptance.\n\n## Requirements: Rich Claude Code Auto Memory reader and linked Markdown navigation

### Context and ownership

Follow-up to **#2689** (closed: current Session → authoritative repo identity → Claude Code Auto Memory directory → safe read-only file list/read). This issue **does not** reopen repository discovery or add a Memory management subsystem.

Current implementation:
- `web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/MemoryView.tsx` renders memory text in a raw `<pre>`; its left file list is clickable but links inside `MEMORY.md` are not memory-aware.
- `web/src/capabilities/claude-code/hooks/useMemory.ts` already prefers `MEMORY.md`, reads bounded chunks, guards Session/repository changes, and exposes `openFile(path)`.
- `web/src/shared/markdown/Markdown.tsx`, `previewPlugins.ts` and `frontmatterTable.ts` already provide GFM, code highlighting, safe Markdown rendering, and YAML/TOML frontmatter presentation. **Reuse them** rather than creating a Claude-specific Markdown parser or a second rendering pipeline.

**User story:** Open the current Session's Claude Code → Memory, read `MEMORY.md` as a structured document, click a topic reference such as `[Architecture](architecture.md)` to open that memory file in place, and read that file's frontmatter and body with normal Markdown presentation.

### Required experience

1. **Document rendering, not raw text by default.** Display `MEMORY.md` and topic `.md` files with the existing shared, sanitized document/Markdown renderer. Preserve headings, paragraphs, emphasis, lists/checklists, tables, blockquotes, code fences/language highlighting, and ordinary Markdown links. Keep existing bounded loading/retry/no-memory/error states. This is a document reader, **not** the chat-stream incremental renderer (#1184).
2. **Index-aware file navigation.** Treat Markdown links in the selected memory file as navigation candidates. For relative Markdown targets inside the **current resolved Memory directory** (examples: `design.md`, `./design.md`, `topics/design.md#principles`), resolve relative to the source file and select the target via the existing `useMemory.openFile`/safe provider read. The left list continues to work; selection is coherent with link navigation, and the reader has an obvious route back to `MEMORY.md` (existing index entry suffices). Do not build a new tree, workspace category, routing product, global project picker, or automatic backlink database.
3. **Headings and fragments.** A `#heading` reference scrolls within the current document; `file.md#heading` opens that same-directory file, then scrolls to the matching heading **after it has rendered**. Preserve normal text selection, keyboard-accessible links, and the reading surface's scroll owner on Web/App; don't let a navigation click send the user to an unintended top-level route.
4. **Frontmatter as readable metadata.** Recognize leading YAML `---` and TOML `+++` frontmatter in memory Markdown; present recognized keys/values in a restrained metadata treatment, separated from the body, reusing `frontmatterTable.ts` / shared document grammar. Preserve content faithfully; don't interpret metadata as permissions, routing instructions, or Nession state. Files without frontmatter render normally; malformed/unsupported frontmatter must not crash the reader or conceal the remaining body. Do not build a configurable frontmatter schema/editor.
5. **Safe, explicit link semantics.** Only navigate as an internal Memory link when the normalized target is a listed, authorized Markdown file from the current `claude-code.memory` snapshot. Percent-encoding, `.` segments, fragments, Unicode names and nested paths need deterministic handling; reject traversal, absolute filesystem paths, symlinks, credentials, cross-project targets and unsafe URI schemes. A missing/unlisted/unsupported target stays in the viewer with a small, truthful non-destructive notice (not a new unrestricted file request); safe `https://` or `http://` links may open externally using the shared external-link security policy. No arbitrary `file://` or `javascript:` navigation. Existing Agent containment checks remain authoritative even if Web validation is bypassed.
6. **Bounded content and stale-state correctness.** Do not read every topic file in advance or auto-follow all links. Respect `hasMore`, byte/chunk limits, pending reads and read failures; show a clear partial-content state when a document is not fully loaded instead of treating its truncated tail as complete Markdown/frontmatter. A fragment not yet loaded cannot falsely scroll to an unrelated heading: allow bounded manual continuation or report that the target is not yet available. When Session, repository/memory directory, or chosen file changes mid-read, old file content/links/scroll effects cannot appear in the new context.
7. **Quiet responsive layout.** Keep this inside the existing Claude Code capability's Memory view: compact file list + document reader on Web, a usable narrow/App flow with readable wrapping and scroll, no new permanent navigation/chrome. Existing source/repository disclosure remains visible without competing with the document.

### Implementation boundaries

- Primary owner: `MemoryView.tsx` + capability-local memory-link/navigation adapter (if needed) + `useMemory.ts` only for actual state/selection transitions; shared Markdown renderer can expose an **optional internal-link handling seam** rather than hardcoding Claude Code path semantics into `shared/markdown`.
- Prefer the existing sanitize/frontmatter/Markdown primitives; avoid new parser dependencies or a second general-purpose Markdown framework.
- Do not modify `claude-code.memory` / `claude-code.memory.read` protocol unless a **demonstrated**, scoped need exists. Remain read-only; no edits, writes, sync, indexing service, background crawling, or new provider-specific metadata persistence.
- Related: #2689 (Memory discovery/read baseline), #195 (generic Markdown preview), #1184 (chat streaming Markdown; different rendering semantics).

### Prototype

- **Decision: Required.** Product owner explicitly requested the linked Memory reader prototype update; preserve the established #2689 IA and change only the in-capability document/navigation flow.
- **Current source:** [Existing Claude Memory interactive prototype — pinned revision](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/ddd62bd13794c5120bd5e347eabd180821b2c291/claude-memory-2689) on the shared orphan `prototype` branch, also linked from the [prototype gallery](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/ddd62bd13794c5120bd5e347eabd180821b2c291/index.html). **Updated in place**, not a duplicate #2742 standalone app.
- **Direct browser HTML:** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/claude-memory-2689/index.html — **new revision not HTTPS/manifest verified** from this environment, and may still show an older deployed commit. Do not count the constructed/previously working route as publication proof.
- **Scenario:** Terminal → Context Capsule `+` → Claude Peek → Workspace Memory → `MEMORY.md` → inline Markdown topic link to `architecture.md#session-boundary` → YAML Frontmatter + table/code → index → TOML topic → partial nested recovery + continue → fragment → safe relative backlink; invalid/missing target notice and raw/preview toggle. Includes Web/App responsive layout and the existing worktree/cross-repository fixtures.
- **Fidelity:** offline synthetic Markdown/data, dependency-free illustrative subset renderer, simulated chunk reads and timing; no real Git/Claude/runtime reads, no provider/filesystem security proof. Production uses shared `web/src/shared/markdown`, not this mock parser.
- **Verification status (verified 2026-11-06):** the Pages direct HTML returned HTTP 200 with title “Nession · Claude Code Memory Markdown reader · #2689 / #2742”; `prototypes/manifest.json` reports source SHA `527d166ae77c8ae7f56c0fc02e044a461d43d578` and the `claude-memory-2689` entry, and the files at that SHA are byte-identical to the immutable pin `ddd62bd13794c5120bd5e347eabd180821b2c291`. Real Chromium at 1440×1000 and 390×844 exercised index → architecture (YAML frontmatter/table/code), back to index → interaction (TOML), partial recovery → continue → Retry strategy, missing/blocked links, raw/preview and the narrow push/detail flow with zero console or page errors. Durable record: `docs/design/design-system/patterns/claude-memory-reader-2742-prototype.md`.
- **Design owner:** this is a revision to the **same** `claude-memory-2689/` interaction artifact; the original #2689 IA proof and former immutable SHA remain historical, not visual proof for #2742.

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 Opening `MEMORY.md` or a topic `.md` presents safe rich Markdown (GFM, code, links, lists, tables) instead of plain `<pre>`, with legible Web/App overflow and no regression to the existing Claude Code capability.
- [x] SC-02 Clicking a valid relative Markdown link in `MEMORY.md` selects/loads the correct in-snapshot topic memory file; `#fragment` and `file.md#fragment` navigate to their target heading after render, and returning to the index remains easy.
- [x] SC-03 Leading valid YAML/TOML frontmatter appears as legible, non-executable metadata alongside the rendered body; missing, malformed and unsupported metadata do not crash the reader or silently lose body content.
- [x] SC-04 Traversal, absolute/cross-repository/unlisted targets and unsafe schemes cannot trigger unauthorized reads/navigation; missing targets give clear feedback and safe web links behave according to the shared external-link policy.
- [x] SC-05 Chunked/incomplete content, failed reads and Session/repository/file switches remain truthful: no unbounded eager loading, no stale cross-Session content or delayed fragment-scroll into the wrong document, and existing no-memory/unavailable/error states still work.
- [x] SC-06 The existing Claude Memory prototype (rather than a duplicate product shell) demonstrates rich Markdown, linked navigation, frontmatter, incomplete/invalid paths, and narrow/App behavior, with an immutable source pin and independently recorded mock/browser/Pages verification status.
